## About

Jacques Azianou is a Nigerian full-stack developer and UI/UX designer specializing in React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, and modern frontend engineering. His work emphasizes performance, accessibility, polished interactions, and modern web standards.
